pages.title: Understand your readiness score on Apple Watch (Apple Support)
pages.reason: Highest-ranking organic result and the first AI Overview citation. It answers the three questions the SERP is built around: which watches show the score, why a score is missing, and how the score is calculated. Official documentation rather than an editorial article, kept in the sample because it is the page every other result paraphrases and a strong brand is not dropped for convenience. It is also the primary source for Apple facts (dual role stated in research.md).

pages.title: How to unlock Apple's new dynamic Readiness Score on your Apple Watch (Tom's Guide)
pages.reason: Highest-ranking editorial article that could be captured in full (position 6, stuff.tv, returned a Cloudflare 403 block and is excluded as inaccessible). Four-step how-to for owners of supported watches, published 2026-10-22. Represents the dominant intent on this SERP: how to get and read Apple's score.
